# Nevisan Tea

Nevisan Tea offers premium, PGS-India certified organic, single-origin whole leaf green and oolong teas from Golaghat, Assam.

Sourced from Tailor Made Tea, Golaghat; managed by Mahabir Enterprise, Guwahati.
Licenses: FSSAI 10325001000313, GSTIN 18AFAPJ8203P1Z7.

"100% whole leaf, single garden, PGS-India certified organic (pesticide-free)."
"No CTC, fannings, dust, artificial sweeteners, or chemical preservatives."
